questions.prompt: Nadia has at most \$60 to spend on art supplies. Sketchbooks cost \$8 each and packs of markers cost \$3 each. Which inequality represents the possible numbers of sketchbooks, \(s\), and packs of markers, \(m\), that Nadia can buy?
